title: New hero: the Vampire
changes: A sixth hero joins the fire: the Vampire, a pale noble who fights with a thin blade and works blood magic.
Every hit he lands drinks back a little of the life he spills, and many of his skills drink even more.
Blood magic costs some of his own HP as well as mana: spend your blood, then take it back from your enemies.
Three skill trees: Blood (blood bolts and a crimson tide), Night (mist, bats, a red stare and nightfall) and Fang (cruel cuts, a pounce and a blood frenzy).
